report_name: New 'Orexin' Ransomware Strain Discovered with Anti-Recovery Tactics

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Orexin ransomware uses vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies and bcdedit to disable other system recovery mechanisms to prevent system restoration.

attack_patterns.name: File and Directory Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Orexin ransomware enumerates all accessible local disks, removable media, and mapped network shares to identify files for encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Orexin ransomware encrypts files across discovered local, removable, and network drives, appending the '.orexin' extension to filenames.

attack_patterns.name: Software Packing
attack_patterns.description: The Orexin ransomware payload is packed with the Themida packer to evade static analysis and signature-based detection.

attack_patterns.name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
attack_patterns.description: Orexin ransomware performs anti-debugging and anti-sandbox checks, such as monitoring execution timing, and terminates its process if an analysis environment is detected.

attack_patterns.name: Replication Through Removable Media
attack_patterns.description: Orexin ransomware is capable of spreading to and encrypting files on removable drives, such as USBs.

malware.name: Orexin
malware.description: A new ransomware strain targeting Windows systems that uses the Themida packer, deletes volume shadow copies, disables recovery features, and spreads to removable drives and network shares. It appends the .orexin extension to encrypted files and drops a ransom note named HOW_TO_RECOVER.txt.

tools.name: Themida
tools.description: Used as a software packer to obfuscate the Orexin ransomware payload and evade detection.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by Orexin ransomware to delete volume shadow copies, a technique to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: bcdedit
tools.description: Used by Orexin ransomware to disable system recovery features by modifying boot configuration data.

infrastructure.name: Orexin Ransomware Contact Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The ransom note instructs victims to contact the attackers via email or Telegram for payment instructions. Specific contact details were not provided in the report.

indicators.name: Orexin Ransomware Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Orexin Ransomware Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c5a8d7e-1b2c-4d3e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the command used by Orexin ransomware to delete volume shadow copies.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-24-jul-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
      - '/all'
      - '/quiet'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of vssadmin.exe to delete all volume shadow copies quietly, a common anti-recovery technique used by Orexin ransomware.

indicators.name: Orexin Ransomware Recovery Disablement via Bcdedit
indicators.pattern:
title: Orexin Ransomware Recovery Disablement via Bcdedit
id: 8b4a7c6d-2a3b-4c5d-9e8f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects commands used by Orexin ransomware to disable system recovery features using bcdedit.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-24-jul-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-24
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_1:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/set'
      - '{default}'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy'
      - 'ignoreallfailures'
  selection_2:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '/set'
      - '{default}'
      - 'recoveryenabled'
      - 'no'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the use of bcdedit.exe to modify boot status policy and disable recovery, an anti-recovery technique used by Orexin ransomware.
